## Interfaces

CLI `bin/aff` → `affidavit.cli`; plugin id `affidavit` (Claude/Cursor); contract `"project": "affidavit"`; sync dest `~/.cursor/plugins/local/affidavit`.

## Assumptions

GitHub rename + plugin resync + AA doc updates are Landing (R4/R6), not this code revision.

## Invariants

One product name `affidavit`, one CLI `aff`; no `bin/se-workflow` / `se_workflow`; foreign-contract stop gates on non-`affidavit`; store history not rewritten for branding.
